results.title: Product Hunt's Hypership Day for Fast Builders and Makers | Ghulam Abbas posted on the topic | LinkedIn
results.content:
Product Hunt is introducing Hypership Day! 🚀🚀 For builders who love moving fast, this is an interesting new format: build, ship, get feedback, and improve in real time. According to Product Hunt, participants who haven’t launched in the last 3 months can submit by September 30. The event will focus on rapid shipping, real-time feature updates, actionable feedback, and community participation. There will also be prizes, including Jev credits, swag, and surprise prizes, with TypeSafe AI and Supabase partnering on the event. For makers, it’s a chance to put a product in front of an active audience and learn directly from users while building. For the community, it’s a chance to discover products as they evolve throughout the day. Build fast. Ship fast. Learn fast. Ship something small and a little embarrassing 2. Talk to every user who tries it 3.   MVPs shouldn’t take months to prove an idea. They should get into users’ hands quickly. The faster you have something real, the faster you can learn: What users actually want .What they ignore. Where they get stuck. What needs to change. You can spend weeks forecasting what the market might do. Or you can build something usable and let real customers tell you. That’s the advantage of a focused MVP. Build fast. Get feedback. Iterate. Because real user feedback will always beat assumptions made in a room. #MVP #Startups #BuildInPublic #ProductDevelopment NitNode Smart Logics LLC
